prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Original medieval grounded RPG LOW RES PIXEL ART location concept, elevated three-quarter cutaway. Coarse square pixel clusters, controlled dark outlines, restrained 3-tone stone timber wool iron, muted earth palette, no smooth painted surfaces or photorealism. No people, no text or labels, no quest UI, no magic, no outcome animation. Daylight. Room/prop geometry is a proposal, not certified collision, official geography, inventory or narrative outcome. Open ordinary return path remains visually distinct. One close elevated cutaway of a modest counting table at edge of a finite material market, backed by dark grey stone and plain timber awning. Table has three spatially separated sections: two small CLOSED cloth household contribution pouches; separate wooden tray for furnace-material expense tokens; an obvious EMPTY place with one unused stool, no coin or pouch there. A short low screen shields individual accounting from public market lane but never blocks exit. Empty low material shelf in background shows finite stock, no gold mountain or bank vault. No donor names, no sums, no new payment, no missing captive returning, no release or contract signature. The image is comparison setup, not proof money arrived.
